extracted.intended_audience: general readers and comedy fans interested in comedian profiles and entertainment
extracted.subtask_description: A short-form entertainment profile summarizing a comedian's life, career highlights, and public advocacy, aimed at informing fans and general readers. Focuses on notable performances, projects, personal challenges, and cultural impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadpan humor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The piece highlights deadpan delivery as a defining stylistic trait that helps carve a unique niche in the comedy landscape; use this descriptor when emphasizing a performer's minimalist/understated comedic style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candid discussion of personal challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Candid discussions about personal challenges (e.g., discussing a cancer diagnosis on stage).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article emphasizes openness about serious personal issues as part of the act — this approach can bring awareness to important topics and deepen audience connection; exemplified by Notaro's 2012 set given days after receiving a cancer diagnosis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Powerful storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Tig Notaro is described as a powerful storyteller whose work resonates with audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Storytelling is presented as central to impact and reach; profiles should note how narrative-driven material contributes to a comedian's resonance and reputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resilience and authenticity
rubrics_metrics.description: Represents resilience and authenticity; willingness to share her story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article frames authenticity and resilience as key attributes that make comedy meaningful and relatable — useful evaluative language when assessing a comedian's cultural significance or emotional impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy and activism
rubrics_metrics.description: Active participation in discussions surrounding mental health and LGBTQ+ issues; using platform to advocate for change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles should record a performer's advocacy work and how their platform extends beyond comedy into activism, including topics they elevate (mental health, LGBTQ+ issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fearlessness / boundary-pushing performances
rubrics_metrics.description: Fearless approach and boundary-pushing material (evidenced by performing shortly after a cancer diagnosis and earning acclaim).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlighting moments of bravery onstage serves as evidence of artistic risk-taking and can explain critical recognition or influence; use concrete examples (dates/events) when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation of significant long-form projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Development of larger creative projects (e.g., semi-autobiographical series 'One Mississippi', critically acclaimed specials).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note a comedian's work across media and formats — TV series, specials — and how semi-autobiographical projects explore life experiences with humor and sensitivity; use these to demonstrate range and career development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-platform audience engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Engaging audiences across platforms such as podcasts, stand-up tours, and specials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profiles should document current/future audience touchpoints (podcasts, tours, announcements) to show ongoing relevance and modes of engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural/significance framing
rubrics_metrics.description: Portrays the subject as a trailblazer whose contributions remain relevant and who uses humor to heal and connect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use language that situates a comedian within broader cultural conversations (trailblazer, influencer) and emphasizes the social/therapeutic functions of their comedy when appropriate.
